style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: chocolate pieces on a cutting board: chocolate keys, a raspberry Enter (chocolate and strawberry), butter-caramel rub out, cream-caramel panel

images.why: Description 'Cut a strip into ten equal parts' and Student controls 'Cut button: splits the bottom strip ... into ten equal parts': the strip is a chocolate bar the child breaks into ten equal pieces. ONE piece with its own bevel, panel and gloss is drawn ten times by the tool, each stretched to its piece rectangle (about 96x84), so the equal widths come from code. An interior crop of a whole bar (retired key 'bar') lost the edge and gloss and read as a flat gradient.
images.prompt: One single square of milk chocolate: a slightly rounded-square block with a raised bevelled edge (a lighter rim at the top left, a darker rim at the bottom right), a pressed-in inner panel, and a glossy highlight from light above, in a warm milk-chocolate brown.

images.why: Student controls 'Shape switch: shows the same whole as a strip or as a circle of ten equal sectors': sectors are slices, and a round cake is the whole children see cut into equal slices. The whole cake is kept (crust ring, rim, top-light) and the tool clips it by circle and sector paths, so the crust shows on each slice's outer arc. A golden cake stays warm under the blue and green tint; pizza is red with toppings, frosting is near-white, and a roti is torn, not sliced.
images.prompt: A round golden sponge cake with a clear, darker golden-brown baked crust ring all around its edge and a soft, lighter golden sponge top, lit gently from above.
